name: Canned Corn 3
description: Historical recipe from Canadian Farm Cook Book (1911). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: sweet corn scraped off cob
ingredients.originalText: 8 cups sweet corn scraped off cob

instructions.text: Let come to a boil and boil for 20 minutes
The jars, new rubbers, tops and rings must be scalded before using
To prepare for table, put on in cold water and let come to a boil
Drain off, put on fresh water again, and let come to a boil
Drain off, fix with cream or milk, thicken with flour

source.originalInstructions:
1. Mix well
2. Let come to a boil and boil for 20 minutes
3. Seal hot
4. The jars, new rubbers, tops and rings must be scalded before using
5. To prepare for table, put on in cold water and let come to a boil
6. Drain off, put on fresh water again, and let come to a boil
7. Drain off, fix with cream or milk, thicken with flour
originalIngredients: 8 cups sweet corn scraped off cob
